CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_audit_created_brin ON audit_events USING brin (created_at)

CREATE TABLE principals (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (kind = 'anonymous'), 
	CHECK (role = 'student')
)

CREATE INDEX ix_principals_expires_at ON principals (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE rate_buckets (
	subject VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	window_start BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (subject, scope, window_start)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_rate_buckets_expires_at ON rate_buckets (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE rule_sets (
	version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	engine_min_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version), 
	UNIQUE (checksum)
)


CREATE TABLE projects (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	course_label VARCHAR(80), 
	unit_label VARCHAR(80), 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('active','deleting')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES principals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE INDEX ix_project_owner_sort ON projects (owner_id, updated_at, id)

CREATE TABLE rule_definitions (
	rule_set_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	definition JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (rule_set_version, rule_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rule_set_version) REFERENCES rule_sets (version)
)


CREATE TABLE sessions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(principal_id) REFERENCES principals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_sessions_expires_at ON sessions (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_sessions_principal_id ON sessions (principal_id)

CREATE TABLE dataset_versions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	row_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, version_number), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, id), 
	CHECK (row_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5000), 
	CHECK (version_number > 0), 
	CHECK (source IN ('manual','csv','seed')), 
	CHECK (status IN ('validating','ready')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE INDEX ix_dataset_versions_project_id ON dataset_versions (project_id)

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	response JSONB NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (principal_id, scope, key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(principal_id) REFERENCES principals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE INDEX ix_idempotency_records_expires_at ON idempotency_records (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_idempotency_records_project_id ON idempotency_records (project_id)

CREATE TABLE analyses (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	dataset_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	configuration JSONB NOT NULL, 
	provenance JSONB NOT NULL, 
	engine_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	rule_set_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	supersedes_analysis_id UUID, 
	failure_code VARCHAR(64), 
	sealed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, dataset_id) REFERENCES dataset_versions (project_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CHECK (status IN ('succeeded','rejected','failed')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(rule_set_version) REFERENCES rule_sets (version)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_analysis_project_sort ON analyses (project_id, created_at, id)

CREATE TABLE dataset_columns (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	dataset_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(32), 
	unit_input VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	unit_canonical VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	dimension_signature JSONB NOT NULL, 
	is_offset BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (dataset_id, role), 
	UNIQUE (dataset_id, position), 
	CHECK (role IN ('independent','dependent')), 
	CHECK (position IN (0,1)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id) REFERENCES dataset_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE dataset_points (
	dataset_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	point_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	x_raw VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	y_raw VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	x_value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	y_value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, point_index), 
	CHECK (point_index BETWEEN 0 AND 4999), 
	CHECK (x_value BETWEEN -1e100 AND 1e100 AND y_value BETWEEN -1e100 AND 1e100), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id) REFERENCES dataset_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE analysis_coefficients (
	analysis_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	standard_error FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	dimension JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (analysis_id, key), 
	UNIQUE (analysis_id, ordinal), 
	CHECK (ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND 2), 
	CHECK (value > '-Infinity'::float8 AND value < 'Infinity'::float8), 
	CHECK (standard_error >= 0 AND standard_error < 'Infinity'::float8), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE analysis_point_results (
	analysis_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	point_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	transformed_x FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	transformed_y FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	predicted_y FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	residual FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (analysis_id, point_index), 
	CHECK (transformed_x > '-Infinity'::float8 AND transformed_x < 'Infinity'::float8), 
	CHECK (transformed_y > '-Infinity'::float8 AND transformed_y < 'Infinity'::float8), 
	CHECK (predicted_y > '-Infinity'::float8 AND predicted_y < 'Infinity'::float8), 
	CHECK (residual > '-Infinity'::float8 AND residual < 'Infinity'::float8), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE analysis_results (
	analysis_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	metrics JSONB NOT NULL, 
	chart_summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (analysis_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE explanations (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	configuration JSONB NOT NULL, 
	cache_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE INDEX ix_explanations_analysis_id ON explanations (analysis_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_explanations_cache_key ON explanations (cache_key)

CREATE TABLE findings (
	analysis_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	display_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (analysis_id, rule_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
